suite: simple-v1 held-out plan (frozen selected-attacks.json), 264 calls per configuration

host.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 24564 MiB (one GPU per process; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1)
host.note: Comparator inference ran on a remote CUDA host, not a laptop.

serving.why_no_merge: kev-9b with the default merged LoRA exceeds 24 GB during .to(cuda) (peak 23.3 GiB, OOM allocating 192 MiB). Unmerged it serves at 16.1 GB. KEV_MERGE=0 is therefore pinned for every size so the family is internally comparable.
serving.merge_is_not_a_no_op: Merged and unmerged runs are retained side by side. On kev-4b they disagree on 4 of 264 decisions (max |delta p(ALLOW)| = 0.0249); on kev-0.8b no decision changes (max 0.0346).

calibration_ab.default: checkpoint-stored temperature applied by the pointer head
calibration_ab.raw: KEV_TEMPERATURE=1.0 set on the server process
calibration_ab.note: Temperature scaling is monotonic, so flips are identical; only the reported distribution changes.

not_run.9b on a second GPU: kev.serve has no device_map; sharding would require patching the loader and the pointer head
